description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905012440446 RESISTOR,FIXED,FILM: Line 0001 Qty 115 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0074 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered.
